// Scratch generator of landscape-quadrant.json, not built by this repo. From a detached acr worktree
// at the producer branch, then `go run ./cmd/zzquadrant <this directory>`, then `prettier --write`
// on the output (whitespace only; the JSON is unchanged). Ran at acr 55b61fd2 (#1963, CHAOS-12626,
// open), on the contract of acr 5cb92237 (#1953, the pin of record).
//
// The shape is the real selector's (`selectRenderShapes`, flag on), with the real served line
// (`withLandscapeLimitation`), vocabulary labels, `Validate` and `json.Marshal`. The claims are built
// as acr's own selection test builds them (`chaos12626_landscape_quadrant_test.go`): each team's two
// claims on one landscape fact, each carrying the fact's one area_breakdown row. The teams are the
// ones `dho fixtures generate` writes for its mixed world (seed 9440), one per provider. Refresh it
// from #1963's merge commit.

// internal/contextfabric/zz_quadrant_export.go
package contextfabric

import (
	"strings"
	"time"

	contractsv1 "github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contracts/v1"
)

// ZZQuadrantTeam is one team's landscape fact: its one area_breakdown row.
type ZZQuadrantTeam struct {
	ID, Label, Day           string
	Identities, Churn, Units int64
}

func zzInteger(value int64) ScalarValue { return ScalarValue{Integer: &value} }

// Scratch only (CHAOS-12624), never committed: a comparison of teams that asks for landscape facts,
// each team claiming both measures from its one landscape fact (one area_breakdown row, as
// attachCanonicalRows gives it), through the real selector with the flag on and the real served line.
func ZZQuadrantResult(teams []ZZQuadrantTeam) InvestigationResult {
	committed := []SubjectRef{}
	claims := []ClaimedFact{}
	for _, team := range teams {
		subject := SubjectRef{Kind: contractsv1.ContextFabricSubjectTeam, CanonicalID: TeamCanonicalID(team.ID), Label: team.Label}
		committed = append(committed, subject)
		day := team.Day
		row := contractsv1.ContextFabricClaimedFactRow{Fields: map[string]ScalarValue{
			"as_of_day": {String: &day}, "identity_count": zzInteger(team.Identities),
			"churn_loc_30d": zzInteger(team.Churn), "delivery_units_30d": zzInteger(team.Units),
		}}
		table := &contractsv1.ContextFabricClaimedFactTable{
			Field: "area_breakdown", Shape: contractsv1.ContextFabricFactTableShapeBreakdown, Key: []string{"as_of_day"},
			Measures: []string{"identity_count", "churn_loc_30d", "delivery_units_30d"},
		}
		name := strings.NewReplacer(":", "_", "/", "_", "-", "_").Replace(team.ID)
		for _, field := range []string{"churn_loc_30d", "delivery_units_30d"} {
			value := team.Churn
			if field == "delivery_units_30d" {
				value = team.Units
			}
			claims = append(claims, ClaimedFact{
				ClaimID: "claim_" + name + "_" + field, FactID: "fact_landscape_" + name, Kind: FactLandscape, Subject: subject,
				Field: field, Value: zzInteger(value), Rows: []contractsv1.ContextFabricClaimedFactRow{row}, Table: table,
			})
		}
	}
	result := InvestigationResult{
		SchemaVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, ResultID: "result_quadrant_0001", RequestID: "request_quadrant_0001",
		GeneratedAt: time.Date(2026, 11, 2, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Status: InvestigationComplete,
		Question: "Where do these teams stand on churn and delivery?",
		Interpretation: InterpretedQuestion{
			Shape: ShapeExplicitCohort, RequestedJudgment: "compare",
			TimeContext:      TimeContext{Axis: TemporalCurrent},
			FactRequirements: []FactRequirement{{Kind: FactLandscape}},
		},
		SubjectResolution:   SubjectResolution{Candidates: []SubjectCandidate{}, Committed: committed},
		DirectJudgment:      "Identity appears to carry the most churn of these teams.",
		CurrentState:        "The teams appear to differ most in churn.",
		StrongestPressures:  []string{},
		Drivers:             []DriverJudgment{},
		RemainingWork:       []Finding{},
		ReadinessGaps:       []Finding{},
		Paths:               []RelationshipPath{},
		Conflicts:           []Finding{},
		Limitations:         []string{},
		EvidenceRefIDs:      []string{},
		Coverage:            Coverage{Sources: []SourceObservation{}, DegradedReasons: []string{}},
		Versions:            VersionSet{ServiceVersion: "test-v1", ContractVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, Backend: "test"},
		DeterministicAnswer: "Identity leans to the most churn of these teams on this day.",
		Warnings:            []string{},
		AnswerPlan: &contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlan{
			Family: QuestionFamilyExplicitComparison, FamilyVersion: QuestionFamilyTableVersion,
			FamilySource: contractsv1.ContextFabricQuestionFamilySourceModel, Budget: contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlanBudget{MaxItems: 400, MaxSerializedBytes: 262144, MaxMembers: 64, SynthesisHeadroom: 40, NarrowingBasis: contractsv1.ContextFabricNarrowingBasisCanonicalIDLexical},
			RenderKinds: []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKind{contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindTable, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindQuadrant},
		},
		ClaimedFacts: claims,
	}
	shapes, event := selectRenderShapes(result, nil, RenderShapeOptions{LandscapePosition: true})
	if err := event.Accounted(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	quadrants := 0
	for _, shape := range shapes {
		if shape.SelectedBy == contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderRuleLandscapePosition {
			quadrants++
		}
	}
	if quadrants != 1 {
		panic("the real selector drew no quadrant")
	}
	result.RenderShapes = shapes
	result.Limitations, _ = withLandscapeLimitation(result.Limitations, shapes)
	result.Completeness = ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

// cmd/zzquadrant/main.go
// Scratch only (CHAOS-12624): the real selector, flag on, then the real vocabulary labels, Validate and encoder.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	// The teams `dho fixtures generate` writes for its mixed world (seed 9440), one per provider,
	// as acr's real-store test reads them (testdata/dho_mixed_s9440_teams.json). Mobile has one
	// identity, so the real rule gives it no point and counts it left out.
	result := contextfabric.ZZQuadrantResult([]contextfabric.ZZQuadrantTeam{
		{ID: "gh:identity", Label: "Identity", Day: "2026-11-02", Identities: 4, Churn: 18240, Units: 46},
		{ID: "gl:chaos-gl", Label: "Delivery", Day: "2026-11-02", Identities: 3, Churn: 9310, Units: 27},
		{ID: "jira:9a1f0c3e-0000-4000-8000-0000000d0001", Label: "Payments", Day: "2026-11-02", Identities: 2, Churn: 0, Units: 9},
		{ID: "linear:CHK", Label: "Checkout", Day: "2026-11-02", Identities: 5, Churn: 2720, Units: 31},
		{ID: "linear:MOB", Label: "Mobile", Day: "2026-11-02", Identities: 1, Churn: 1200, Units: 3},
	})
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("contracts/examples/v1/context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json")
	must(err)
	var example contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &example))
	result.Versions = example.Versions
	served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(result, true, 262144)
	must(served.Validate())
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(served, "", "    ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Args[1], "landscape-quadrant.json"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
	fmt.Printf("tier=%s shapes=%d bytes=%d\n", tier, len(served.RenderShapes), len(encoded))
}
